hypotheses.statement: Shallow focus isolates delicate blossoms against a soft architectural backdrop, creating intimate foreground emphasis with dreamy context.
Left-heavy organic mass balanced against a dark vertical tower on the right edge creates tension between nature and architecture.
Large pale sky void and limited low-saturation palette produce a light, calm, airy spring mood.

relations.rule: Keep one sharp organic subject filling the left two-thirds with a heavily blurred contextual backdrop confined to the right third.
Preserve ~40% pale negative space in the upper center-right to keep the composition airy and uncluttered.
Restrict palette to ~3 low-saturation hues with light dominant tones.

fragile_if_changed: Bringing the background building into sharp focus would destroy the soft foreground isolation and airy spring calm that defines the image.

hypotheses.statement: Low-key surrounding darkness isolates the large bright silver mass, creating a gallery-spotlight hierarchy and premium moody emphasis.
Tiny complementary red-on-car versus distant blue-in-background accents create color tension and depth that prevents the monochrome silver-black field from feeling flat.
Diagonal recession to the upper left plus bottom-right foreground occlusion creates immersive show-floor depth and forward motion.

relations.rule: Keep a single hero subject covering ~65-80% of frame width with dark negative space surrounding it to preserve spotlight hierarchy.
Restrict saturated warm accent to <6% of frame placed directly on the hero to anchor focus.
Limit palette to near-monochrome base plus at most two small complementary warm and cool accents.

fragile_if_changed: Lifting the surrounding near-black shadows to bright even light would collapse the low-key spotlight isolation that makes the silver body read as sculpted and heroic.

hypotheses.statement: The hard vertical yellow-versus-black split creates bold, confrontational tension and makes the profile read instantly at distance.
Extreme scale contrast with giant cropped letters as background texture versus tiny left-column text establishes a two-level hierarchy: impact first, information second.
A single tiny warm accent at the bottom anchors the eye after scanning down the left column and marks release information without competing with the main contrast.
Bright white spectacles placed exactly on the yellow-black seam act as a bridge and focal point, humanizing the solid silhouette and linking the two halves.

relations.rule: Keep a ~50/50 flat-color field versus solid silhouette split, with giant display type cropped by the frame edge and partially overlapped by the silhouette.
Maintain display cap-height to body cap-height ratio >=8:1, with display used as cropped background texture and body confined to a narrow column.

fragile_if_changed: Replacing the flat high-chroma yellow field with a gradient, texture, or muted tone would collapse the hard yellow-black-white confrontation that defines the image.

hypotheses.statement: A single-hero hierarchy works because the dark coupe dominates scale and sharpness while the yellow car provides a smaller, saturated counterpoint for depth and tension.
The low wheel-height three-quarter view emphasizes length, stance and presence, making the car feel grounded on the pavement.
The vast desaturated sky and pavement envelope creates a muted, overcast meet mood that lets tiny warm accents carry emphasis.

relations.rule: Keep one hero object spanning >3/4 width in the lower two-thirds with secondary objects partially occluded behind it.
Restrict base to desaturated neutrals plus maximum two warm accent hues.
Confine all saturated color to <10% total area in secondary or detail zones, never in sky or ground base.

fragile_if_changed: Raising the viewpoint to high eye-level and brightening the overcast sky to sunny high-key would destroy the low, grounded, moody hero-car character.
